Adapt a base-R family to an evaluable family_spec

Source: R/family_spec.R
as_family_spec.Rd

Wraps a base-R / brms family object (which exposes linkinv but no pointwise log-likelihood) with the loglik_pointwise and rng functions koine needs. Supported families in this build are gaussian, binomial (and bernoulli, a binomial with one trial), and poisson. An unsupported family raises error.family_not_evaluable, never a silent approximation.

Usage

as_family_spec(family, trials = NULL)

Arguments

family

A base-R family object (e.g. gaussian(), binomial()), or a single string naming one.

trials

Optional length-N integer vector of binomial trial counts; defaults to 1 (the Bernoulli case).

Value

A koine_family_spec.

Examples

fs <- as_family_spec(gaussian())
fs$loglik_pointwise(y = c(0, 1), eta = c(0, 1), aux = list(sigma = 1))
#> [1] -0.9189385 -0.9189385
